provenance.qualification: Computed Encke Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. This smooth model follows one published radar and infrared solution for Encke. Its shape depends on the assumed tumbling motion. The grid marks absent surface photographs; the orientation is illustrative.
